summary: Verified both PWA standalone bug fixes for iteration 22. (1) StandaloneRedirector now correctly allows /terapeuta and /admin routes AND role-aware fallback destination works — terapeuta lands on /terapeuta, admin lands on /admin, paziente on /paziente. Navigation from /terapeuta to /terapeuta/calendario in standalone mode no longer redirects back to /paziente. (2) The 'CONSIGLIATO Esercizio resp…' floating chip has been removed from PazienteHome — no element with data-testid='home-consigliato-chip' present. All regressions passed: paziente primary card (NextSessionCard 'Sessione con Maria Rossi') renders, bottom nav shows Home/Diario/Chat/Profilo, marketing routes (/blog, /chi-siamo) still redirect to /paziente, and normal browser mode still works.
critical_code_review_comments: StandaloneRedirector implementation is clean and role-aware. Allowlist covers all necessary paths (login, register, otp, reset-password, seduta/, payment/). Consider whether /questionario should stay in the allowlist when running standalone as an admin/therapist (currently harmless but slightly odd).
The useStandalone hook's sessionStorage persistence via ?app=1 is a great test affordance.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Standalone PWA mode simulated via ?app=1 query string on initial navigation (useStandalone hook persists in sessionStorage). Cookie banner blocks form submissions on first load — must click 'Accetta tutti' button before filling login form. Both bugs from user report are fully resolved as of iter 22.
